title: Envio Svm Config Schema
description: Schema for a YAML config for an envio Svm indexer

handlers.description: Optional relative path to handlers directory for auto-loading. Defaults to 'src/handlers' if not specified.

full_batch_size.description: Target number of events to be processed per batch. Set it to smaller number if you have many Effect API calls which are slow to resolve and can't be batched. (Default: 5000)

storage.description: Storage backends the indexer writes data to. Defaults to Postgres when omitted. Set `clickhouse: true` to additionally sync the indexed data to ClickHouse. Mark a backend with `default: true` to store entities that don't have an @storage directive in the schema, e.g. `clickhouse: {default: true}`.

disable_default_cross_chain.description: Make entities and effect caches per-chain instead of shared across every chain (recommended). Sharing then becomes explicit — add `@crossChain` to an entity in schema.graphql or `crossChain: true` to an effect. (default: false)

chains.description: Configuration of the blockchain chains that the project is deployed on.

postgres.description: Whether to use Postgres as a storage backend (default: true). Accepts a boolean or an options object (the object form implies the backend is enabled).

default.description: Whether entities without an @storage directive are stored in this backend (default: true when Postgres is the only enabled backend, false otherwise).

column_name_format.description: How entity fields are reflected in the storage column names. `original` keeps the schema.graphql field names as is, `snake_case` converts them to snake_case in the database while keeping the original casing in the exposed APIs. (default: original)

clickhouse.description: Whether to additionally sync the indexed data to ClickHouse. Requires Postgres to be enabled (default: false). Accepts a boolean or an options object (the object form implies the backend is enabled).

default.description: Whether entities without an @storage directive are stored in this backend (default: false).

column_name_format.description: How entity fields are reflected in the storage column names. `original` keeps the schema.graphql field names as is, `snake_case` converts them to snake_case in the database while keeping the original casing in the exposed APIs. (default: original)

skip.description: Excludes the chain from indexing and migrations. Code generation is unaffected. For testing, prefer using a test framework instead.

rpc.description: RPC endpoint URL for connecting to the Svm cluster to fetch blockchain data. Required unless `experimental` is set, in which case it is ignored in favour of the experimental HyperSync source.

start_block.description: The slot number at which the indexer should start ingesting data

end_block.description: The slot number at which the indexer should terminate.

block_lag.description: The number of blocks behind the chain head that the indexer should lag. Useful for avoiding reorg issues by indexing slightly behind the tip.

experimental.description: Experimental HyperSync-backed instruction indexing. This config shape Veil change in future releases.

hypersync_config.description: HyperSync Config for fetching historical instructions on this chain.

programs.description: Solana programs to index on this chain.

url.description: URL of the HyperSync endpoint (default: the public Solana HyperSync endpoint at https://solana.hypersync.xyz)

name.description: A unique project-wide name for this program (used in generated code).

program_id.description: Base58-encoded program id (32 bytes). Each program id may appear once per chain: two entries sharing one would put their instructions in the same routing pool with nothing to tell them apart.

handler.description: Optional relative path to a file where handlers are registered for the given program. If not provided, handlers can be auto-loaded from the src directory.

idl.description: Path (relative to the project root) to an Anchor or Codama IDL JSON file. Every instruction the runtime can decode is indexed; subset the file to index fewer.
